tools.description: Use when you need dated, source-linked coverage of an AI-engineering product, company or topic (agents, MCP, coding tools, model releases) without crawling the web. Searches New Runtime's Field Notes, Raw Signals and Analyses; returns up to 10 hits with title, date, one-line summary and URL. Free, n

tools.name: get_record
tools.description: Use after search_archive, whats_new or what_changed to read one record in full: title, dates, source URLs, topics and body text. Pass the newruntime.com URL you got, or kind + slug. Free, no auth. Example: {"url": "https://newruntime.com/signals/<slug>/"}.

tools.name: get_latest_metadox
tools.description: Use when you want one synthesis of the week in AI engineering instead of a list: the newest weekly metadox (the week's central contradiction, counter-evidence and dated forecasts) as Markdown, up to 12,000 characters, with title, date and URL. Free, no auth. No arguments.

tools.name: get_topic_brief
tools.description: Use when you need the background on one AI-engineering topic in one call: its summary, what was published on it in the last fortnight, and the top related patterns, shifts, field notes and news signals with URLs. Free, no auth. Example: {"topic": "coding-agents"}. Topic list: https://newruntime.com/

tools.name: get_submission_status
tools.description: Moderation status of a source, correction or usage receipt you submitted (received, accepted, rejected...), by its as_... submission id. Shows only the public moderation fields.

tools.name: submit_source
tools.description: Propose a source (primary page, paper, repo, docs) for a New Runtime record or topic. Free. Submissions are not published. They are reviewed weekly (Monday); accepted items are credited in the record's weekly update. Returns a submission id and a status URL. Schema: https://newruntime.com/agent-inbo

tools.name: submit_correction
tools.description: Report a claim in a published record as outdated, unsupported or contradicted, with evidence. Free. Submissions are not published. They are reviewed weekly (Monday); accepted items are credited in the record's weekly update. Schema: https://newruntime.com/agent-inbox/schema.json.

tools.name: submit_usage_receipt
tools.description: Record that you used a New Runtime record and for what (optionally where it can be seen). Free; helps the weekly desk see which records matter. Submissions are not published. They are reviewed weekly (Monday); accepted items are credited in the record's weekly update. Schema: https://newruntime.com/

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_archive, get_record, get_latest_metadox, get_topic_brief · Private data: get_record, contextualize_url, get_forecasts, list_agent_tasks, submit_source, submit_correction, submit_usage_receipt · Public sink: contextualize_url, list_agent_tasks, submit_source, submit_correction, submit_usage_receipt · Destructive: what_changed.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_archive, get_record, get_latest_metadox, get_topic_brief · Private data: get_record, contextualize_url, get_forecasts, list_agent_tasks, submit_source, submit_correction, submit_usage_receipt · Public sink: contextualize_url, list_agent_tasks, submit_source, submit_correction, submit_usage_receipt · Destructive: what_changed

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
